name: rssdoge

scripts.deploy: npm run check && npm run build && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.toml --var BUILD_TIME:$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ) --var RELEASE:$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.dev: ./node_modules/.bin/dotenvx run -- wrangler dev --port 3000 --var TELEGRAM_TOKEN:"$TELEGRAM_TOKEN" --var SENTRY_DSN:"$SENTRY_DSN" --var ENVIRONMENT:development --var BUILD_TIME:$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ) --var RELEASE:$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")

author: melkikh <melkih.a.a@gmail.com>
//: @extractus/feed-extractor was fixed on 7.0.9 to avoid issues with Buffer API in the cloudflare workers
